name: CMS Open Payments
summary: US Open Payments data from CMS: payments and transfers of value from drug and device makers to physicians and teaching hospitals queried through the site's DKAN catalog and datastore API.
notes: New endpoints appear with each data publication: list the current datasets with datasets.list (pass show-reference-ids to get the distribution ids the datastore calls take), then query a dataset by its id and distribution index.
Page datastore.query with limit and offset. datastore.sql caps a request at 500 records: page it with [LIMIT 500 OFFSET n].
Responses are JSON by default; CSV is available with format=csv. Under high load queries may get 503 with Retry-After: drop conditions, sorts and offsets, or wait.

show_reference_ids.description: Include the identifiers of referenced objects, such as distribution ids the datastore endpoints need.
Include the identifiers of referenced objects.

endpoints.name: Search datasets
endpoints.summary: Full-text search over the dataset catalog, with facets for theme, keyword and publisher.

fulltext.description: Full-text search over indexed metadata fields.

sort.description: Property to sort on: description, keyword, modified, publisher__name, temporal, theme, title, search_api_relevance.

endpoints.name: Query a dataset's records
endpoints.summary: Records of one dataset distribution, with conditions, sorts, selected properties and paging, as JSON or CSV.

index.description: Index of the distribution in the dataset's distribution array; 0 for the first.

conditions.description: Conditions, ANDed: objects with property, value and operator (=, <>, <, <=, >, >=, like, between, in, not in, contains, starts with, match; = by default), or groups {groupOperator: and|or, conditions: [...]}.

sorts.description: Sort directives: objects with property and order (asc or desc).

limit.description: Maximum records to return, at least 1.

count.description: Return the total matching count, ignoring limit and offset; true by default.

results.description: Return the records; set false with count true for a count only.

schema.description: Return the column schema; true by default.

keys.description: Return records as keyed objects (true, default) or arrays of values.

notes: A read over POST: the body is a query, nothing is changed.

endpoints.name: Query the datastore with SQL
endpoints.summary: A bracketed SQL-like SELECT over one distribution, e.g. [SELECT a,b FROM <distribution-id>][WHERE c = "X"][LIMIT 500 OFFSET 0].

query.description: The query; SELECT, WHERE and LIMIT ... OFFSET each in their own brackets, no spaces between selected columns.

show_db_columns.description: Return the database column names (no spaces, possibly truncated), which WHERE and SELECT need.

notes: FROM takes a distribution id, not a dataset id: get it from datasets.list with show-reference-ids.

endpoints.name: Get datastore statistics
endpoints.summary: Row and column counts and the column headers of one datastore resource.
